root_idea.summary: The root centers on the idea of an origin, reference point, or gathering center, extending to a community, shared way, exemplar, and directed movement toward a goal.
root_idea.development: From the notions of source and reference arise the senses of mother, foundation, community or religious way, leader or model, nearness or what lies ahead, and purposeful direction. Classical evidence also preserves independent branches for time, stature, bodily injury, and related compounds.

senses.definition: An exemplar, guide, leader, or other person or authoritative thing followed as a model.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for persons who lead or are taken as examples, and for an authoritative guide, record, or scripture whose direction or pattern is followed. Quranic contexts include both righteous leaders and leaders who lead toward error.

senses.definition: A book, register, or written record in which things are preserved or recorded.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic constructions, the referent may be a record of deeds, a scripture or law associated with a people, or a comprehensive clear register.
Used of a route that is followed and clearly discernible, including a traveled highway.
The Quran uses the word for a human mother and, in the plural, for mothers. It also occurs in relational expressions such as “mothers of the believers.”

senses.definition: The source, origin, foundation, or central basis of something.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic compounds this includes the Mother of the Book, understood as its originating or preserved foundation, and the Mother of the Towns, a central metropolis. The sense may also denote what gathers or supports what is associated with it.
In the expression فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ, the word is interpreted as the place to which a person belongs or returns, namely the Fire.

senses.definition: A community, nation, people, tribe, or collective kind of living beings.
senses.usage_conditions: The unifying feature may be religion, shared affiliation, place, time, or a common natural pattern. The Quran also applies the plural to animal and bird communities, so the sense is not restricted to human nations.

senses.definition: A religious way, religion, or shared course of conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a community’s religious path or for the way of life and practice that its members follow.
Used for a period of waiting or elapsed time, and for people understood as belonging to one generation or age.

senses.definition: A single exemplary person who represents, embodies, or gathers the qualities of a community.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially associated with Abraham: one person standing in the place of a group through devotion, righteousness, or exemplary leadership.

Used of persons who have not learned the acquired arts of reading and writing, or who remain in the natural condition in which they were born. The Quran applies it to the unlettered people and to the Prophet in this sense.

senses.definition: Gentile or belonging to a people without a revealed scripture.
senses.usage_conditions: A related Quranic interpretation connects the word with the Arab nation or with people who do not possess a revealed book; this contextual sense overlaps with, but is not identical to, inability to read or write.

senses.definition: One who heads toward, repairs to, or deliberately seeks a destination.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the plural active participle describes those heading to the Sacred House; the lexical sense is purposeful direction rather than a restriction to one type of visitor.

senses.definition: Before, in front of, or what lies ahead.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a locative or adverbial expression for the place or direction in front of someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aim at, turn toward, seek, pursue, intend, or endeavor to reach something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb of purposeful direction; it includes taking a course toward a person, thing, or goal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or wound the head so that the blow reaches the brain-covering region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The resulting wound is the آَمَّة or مَأْمُومَة, a severe head wound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To precede, go before, or lead people as an example.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of leading people, including taking precedence in prayer or serving as an object of imitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become a mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine verb is used of a woman who has become a mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act as a mother to someone or provide mother-like care.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes being or treating oneself as a mother, as in an older female relative serving in a mother-like role.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree or correspond with something without exceeding or falling short of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form III usage describing conformity or exact correspondence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or adopt a woman as a mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived reflexive usage describing adoption or choosing someone as a mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow someone’s example, imitate him, or adopt him as a model or guide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object followed may be a person, rule, way, or other exemplar; the construction with بِهِ identifies the model followed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The female parent of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Arabic application of the ordinary maternal noun to animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An angry or emphatic imprecation concerning someone’s mother; sometimes a forceful expression of affection or praise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression whose literal maternal wording may convey blame, reproach, admiration, or vehemence rather than a literal wish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two parents, or a mother and maternal aunt or grandmother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional dual or kinship expression with extended reference beyond one biological mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What relationship, concern, or connection do I have with him or it?
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom expressing remoteness or lack of concern; the maternal noun is not understood literally in this construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The source, origin, foundation, supporting basis, or encompassing center of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the parent stock of a growing plant, a thing to which related things are gathered, and figurative governing bases such as laws or principles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or chief of a people or company.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The chief is so called because others gather around or depend upon him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person responsible for the food, service, or practical management of a group; a servant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social-role usage, distinct from the general sense of chief or source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man’s aged wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic conventional application of the maternal term to a wife.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ensign, standard, or cloth attached to and wound around a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression denotes the standard followed by an army and, specifically, the cloth or banner on the spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A component of fixed animal names, including the hyena, she-ass, and female ostrich.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are conventional compound names beginning with أُمّ and are not literal references to a mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The brain, its covering, or the membrane or sac enclosing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may refer to the brain itself or to the meningeal covering, depending on the lexical authority and context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Milky Way; according to another interpretation, the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed astronomical expression explained as the place where stars are gathered, with an alternative interpretation identifying the sun as the greatest star.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In fixed compounds, the central, principal, or characteristic instance of a class: for example, a metropolis, the main road, a desert, a cemetery, bread or an ear of grain, wine, or the source of good or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical compounds include أُمُّ القُرَى, أُمُّ الطَّرِيقِ, أُمُّ التَّنَائِفِ, أُمُّ عَامِرٍ, أُمُّ جَابِرٍ, أُمُّ الخَبَائِثِ, أُمُّ الخَيْرِ, and أُمُّ الشَّرِّ. Quranic Mother-of-the-Book and Mother-of-the-Towns uses are assigned to the Quranic foundation sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obedience, especially obedience rendered to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic abstract use of أُمَّة distinct from the Quranic community, religious-way, time, and exemplary-person senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s stature, bodily form, face, or principal facial appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing tallness, beauty or justness of stature, the face, or the principal part of the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A singular learned, religious, or otherwise outstanding person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic specialization for someone without equal in learning or someone alone in a religious commitment; it is distinct from the Quranic collective and exemplary-person uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or performance of serving as an imam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the manner or practice of leading in the capacity of an imam.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state, condition, manner, or mode of being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic nominal usage, separate from the noun إِمَام and from the community noun أُمَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ease, prosperity, welfare, or an ample and pleasant condition of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a favorable state in which means of subsistence and enjoyment are available.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dominion, mastery, or authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized abstract noun for power or control.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blessing, favor, benefit, or boon bestowed by God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is associated with something sought or pursued because it brings happiness or benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nearness; being near, within reach, or opposite or facing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a near place or person, something readily reached, or a position facing another place. The term can also describe an intermediate distance between near and far.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Moderate, suitable, clear, or conforming to the proper mean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an affair, case, or thing that is neither excessive nor deficient and remains within due bounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recognized institutional leader or guide, including a prophet, caliph, prayer leader, sectarian authority, army leader, camel guide, or manager.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized Classical Arabic roles derived from the general notion of one followed, obeyed, or relied upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The daily lesson learned by a boy at school.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A schoolroom technical usage, also called السَّبَق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A model or pattern of a shape or appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical extension of the sense of exemplar to a form or visual pattern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A builder’s rule, leveling instrument, or cord used to make a course of construction even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the wooden tool or the stretched line used to align stones or bricks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction of the qiblah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized directional usage referring to the direction toward which one faces in prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tract, quarter, or region of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic extension of the notion of a defined way or area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A string, such as the string of a bow or lute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun, distinct from the builder’s alignment cord.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful in stature or bodily form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a man of handsome or well-formed stature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wounded in the head or suffering from a wound reaching the brain-covering region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also be used metaphorically of another part of the body said to be wounded by pain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone, or stones, with which heads are broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular and plural interpretations vary by authority; the lexical branch refers to a head-breaking stone or weapon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Three hundred camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional numerical or collective usage attributed to a Classical Arabic authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blacksmith’s hammer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate technical noun from the numerical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A Shiite sect that holds that ʿAlī was expressly appointed as Muhammad’s successor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical sectarian designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inarticulate, sparing in speech, or rude and uncivil in manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic specialization applied to a person whose speech is weak or whose manner is churlish; it is not the Quranic literacy sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The condition of being unlettered or remaining without learned reading and writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun corresponding to أُمِّيّ, including the associated state of natural or unacquired knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe head wound that reaches the brain-covering region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The wound leaves only a thin layer between itself and the brain and is also called مَأْمُومَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Better or more capable in performing the office of imam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative adjective used with مِنْ and historically derived from a form with two hamzas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that leads and guides other camels, or a guide who shows the right way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine may describe a she-camel that goes before the others and is followed by them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose hump or back has been internally bruised, swollen, corroded, or stripped by riding or saddle injury.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of damage caused by repeated riding, chafing, beating, or sores.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Following someone as an example, imitating him, or taking him as a model.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle is used for the person who follows or imitates an exemplar.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Followed or imitated as an example, pattern, or model.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle with بِهِ distinguishes the person or thing that is taken as the model.

cautions: The Lane material uses the contracted root spelling ام and includes several homonymous or derived branches; Classical-only specializations are kept separate from Quranic form senses.
The Quranic form آمّ is presented under its active-participle citation form; its Quranic plural occurrence means those heading toward the Sacred House, not a separate noun meaning.

The interpretations of أُمِّيّ as ‘unlettered’ and as ‘Gentile or belonging to a people without scripture’ overlap in some Quranic contexts and are preserved as distinct explanatory senses because the lexical evidence gives both.
One Lane transmitted expression under أُمّ is left unresolved because its interpretation varies between different laws and different times.
